title: Demonstrations
intro: I offer voluntary demonstrations and workshops on handmade Pugliese pasta — orecchiette, cavatelli, strascinati, troccoli and other traditional forms — in private homes, at community events, and in cultural settings across London. There is no charge. Spigadolce is not a business; it is an act of love for a tradition I do not want to see disappear.

events.title: A Taste of Puglia
events.venue: The Upper Place, 1st floor, Nag's Head Market
events.description: A day entirely dedicated to the flavours of Puglia. I will be giving live orecchiette-making demonstrations throughout the afternoon — come and try your hand at shaping the little ears of durum wheat that generations of Apulian women have made on wooden boards since time immemorial.
events.ticketsNote: £3.96 entry (free for Pugliesi nel Mondo UK members)

associationText: I am an active volunteer member of Pugliesi nel Mondo UK, a non-profit association dedicated to preserving and promoting the cultural heritage of Apulia within the United Kingdom. The association creates a bridge between Puglia and Britain — through cultural events, community gatherings, and the shared love of a region, its traditions, and its people.
inviteText: If you would like to include a Pugliese pasta demonstration at your community event, cultural setting, school, library or private gathering, I would be delighted to hear from you. All demonstrations are offered freely and with no commercial purpose.
